text:
ConocoPhillips rose 1.6% today, continuing a three-day rally that's brought the stock up nearly 4% since November 10th. The move aligns with a modest recovery in oil prices—US crude is trading around $89.62 per barrel—and investor appetite for energy stocks has picked up after a broader two-week decline. The stock was among the day's discussed calls on CNBC, which can draw attention and trading interest to the name.

The underlying headwind remains real, though: Russian crude production has rebounded to 8.73 million barrels a day, pushing global oil markets back into surplus, which typically pressures prices and energy company profits. That structural shift explains why ConocoPhillips has still lost 7.6% over the past two weeks despite today's bounce.
